messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT ALERT - model-serving.canary cluster reporting elevated 5xx and garbled token outputs. severity=sev2 tags=[deploy,canary,tokenizer] runbook=https://internal/runbooks/model-rollout

opsbot: details: spike started ~19:20 UTC, ~40% of canary requests failing, errors include TokenizerError and ModelInferenceError. paging oncall=sara for initial triage.

sara: on it. confirming impact and will assemble oncall + ml.

minh: looking at canary logs now, preliminary: weightset v2.1 promoted but metadata points to vocab v3 instead of v2. tokenizer vocab mismatch during init.

alex: seeing outputs like: 
```
TokenizerError: vocab length mismatch: expected=50257 got=50260
Traceback (most recent call last) ...
ModelInferenceError: kv-cache seed mismatch
```

alex: also seeing short, garbled completions (weird tokens) from ~19:19 UTC matching deploy window.

minh: confirmed artifact tag mismatch in promotion service: payload had weights: "redwood-model-x@v2.1" but tokenizer_ref: "tokenizer-v3". automated validator missed because checksum field present but points to wrong artifact.

jamie: support: two customers reported garbled responses, no PII. opening incident tickets and flagging SLA risk.

sara: priority = stop rollout and cut traffic from canary. apply featureflag:rollouts.model-serving=false for canary pool. devon can you flip? :alarm_clock:

devon: flipping flag to false for canary now. doing gradual cutover to stable routing.

devon: flag flipped at 19:27:03 UTC. routing change applied, canary traffic -> stable. verifying...

opsbot: ACTION: featureflag change observed by infra. traffic shift 80% -> stable, 100% expected in ~30s.

alex: rolling forward not safe. recommend immediate rollback to model x@v2.0 (last known good). hotpatching tokenizer risky.

minh: agreed. preparing rollback artifact v2.0 and regenerating shard map. ETA ~6m to stage.

sara: initiate rollback then. call cutover when ready. notify customers and support. jamie, coordinate comms. lina, FYI for external comms.

jamie: I'll post a proactive note to affected customers: "We observed degraded outputs during a canary model rollout. We've paused the rollout and are restoring previous model. Investigating root cause and will follow up."

minh: staging rollback package ready. running smoke tests.

alex: smoke tests green on staging. ready to promote v2.0 to canary/stable. pushing promote command: `deploy promote redwood-model-x@v2.0 --targets=canary,stable --force`

opsbot: DEPLOY ACTION logged by deploybot user at 19:33:12 UTC. promoting redwood-model-x@v2.0.

devon: cutover completed 19:35:40 UTC. canary healthy, 5xx rate back to baseline.

opsbot: post-cut metrics: canary 5xx -> 0.3% (baseline 0.4), tokenization errors -> 0.

jamie: support: customer tickets updated, two customers acknowledged communications. no escalations.

lina: thanks. capture root cause: artifact promotion service allowed mismatched tokenizer_ref during release. need stricter validation.

minh: immediate mitigations: (1) tighten promotion validator to compare tokenizer SHA against expected model manifest, (2) block promotions that reference tokenizer not in same release family, (3) add unit test for artifact metadata parity.

alex: ops mitigations: (1) add canary-level sanity check to compare vocab length at startup and abort if mismatch, (2) add auto-rollback trigger on TokenizerError spike threshold.

sara: incident status: mitigated, rollback completed, customers notified, oncall will hand off to follow-up owner. assign follow-ups: minh (root cause fixes), alex/devon (auto-rollback + startup check), jamie/lina (customer comms + internal postmortem).

devon: creating follow-up tickets: INFRA-2042 (canary startup checks), DEPLOY-1867 (promotion validator), PM-513 (customer comms).

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to sev3. incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.

sara: handing off to follow-up owners. I'll write a short timeline and ops checklist in the incident doc. good job everyone. :thumbsup:

minh: note for postmortem: observed metadata drift only on promotions that used the new CI path. possible race between metadata writer and artifact signer. will include sample diffs.

alex: saving logs and sample garbled outputs to incident bucket s3://redwood-incidents/7281234567/ for analysis.

jamie: leaving a short customer-facing blurb in #customers-affected at 19:50 UTC.

lina: will schedule a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow to triage and prioritize fixes.

opsbot: incident closed (mitigated) for now; follow-ups created.
